# AURA

> AURA is a premium real-time chat web app: direct messages, group chats, classes (channels), 24-hour stories, reactions, and live presence.

AURA focuses on instant messaging, private DMs, group conversations, classroom-style channels with announcements, and ephemeral stories. The marketing site lives at the homepage; the product itself is behind authentication and is not indexable.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and sign-up call to action.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Email and Google authentication for AURA.
